note: Checks of each camera fit against CBET 3423, made while the cameras were being calibrated; moved here from events/chelyabinsk-2013/picks.json on 27 Oct 2026 so that no agent input holds a published value. Keys ending _v1/_v2 belong to earlier fits of the same camera.

check_against_cbet.method: angle between each SAM head-point ray and the plane through the camera and the published CBET line (not used in the fit)
check_against_cbet.note: the low tail comes from flare frames, where the glow centre sits above the head

check_against_cbet.diagnosis: not usable yet: poles near the edges bow like barrel distortion, which a pinhole without k1 and with roll fixed at 0 cannot follow; next is a plumb-line fit of k1 and roll from several poles; the tower top also suggests it is taller than the 30 m default

check_against_cbet_v2.note: down from 3.43 deg; a 1 deg bias remains, likely the vanishing-point pixel or k1-only distortion; no plumb lines exist left of x=250, where the fireball is

check_against_cbet_v1.diagnosis: not usable: a 9 deg miss is an identification error, not a parameter error. The track sits about 10 deg higher and further west than CBET predicts, so the tower or chimney is probably a different OSM object, or the catalog position is not where this camera stood
